python3 - <<'PY'
import json, os
from datetime import datetime, timezone, timedelta
TZ = timezone(timedelta(hours=8))
day = '2026-11-09'
paths = [
    os.path.expanduser('~/Desktop/CHcode/omdb/tgbot/data/task_provenance.jsonl'),
    os.path.expanduser('~/Library/Application Support/youchu-agent-bus/state/youchu_ai_inbox.jsonl'),
    os.path.expanduser('~/Desktop/CHcode/omdb/tgbot/incoming/worker_ant_agent_bus_inbox.jsonl'),
]
for p in paths:
    print('===', p, 'exists=', os.path.exists(p))
    if not os.path.exists(p):
        continue
    n=0
    with open(p, 'r', encoding='utf-8', errors='replace') as f:
        for line in f:
            line=line.strip()
            if not line: continue
            try:
                o=json.loads(line)
            except Exception:
                continue
            # try find date fields
            blob = json.dumps(o, ensure_ascii=False)
            ts = o.get('ts') or o.get('time') or o.get('created_at') or o.get('timestamp') or ''
            if isinstance(ts, (int,float)):
                try:
                    ts = datetime.fromtimestamp(ts/1000 if ts>1e12 else ts, TZ).isoformat()
                except Exception:
                    ts=str(ts)
            if day not in str(ts) and day not in blob[:200]:
                # also check nested
                if day not in blob:
                    continue
            src = o.get('source') or o.get('kind') or o.get('from') or ''
            text = o.get('text') or o.get('summary') or o.get('payload') or o.get('message') or ''
            if isinstance(text, dict):
                text = text.get('text') or text.get('prompt') or str(text)[:200]
            text = str(text).replace('\n',' ')[:180]
            bus = o.get('bus_id') or o.get('id') or o.get('reply_to') or ''
            print(f'{ts}|src={src}|bus={bus}|{text}')
            n+=1
            if n>=40:
                print('...truncated')
                break
    print('shown', n)
PY
